summary.en: Needs come first: food, school, the bus. Wants are fine too, once they fit inside your plan.

keyNumber.en: ₹10 a day on wants = ₹3,650 a year.

summary.en: Pay yourself first. Put the savings aside the day money comes, not with whatever is left.

keyNumber.en: ₹5 a day saved = ₹1,825 a year.

summary.en: Prices rise a little every year. Cash kept idle buys less and less.

keyNumber.en: At 6% a year, a ₹10 chocolate costs about ₹18 in 10 years.

summary.en: A bank keeps money safe from rats, thieves and quick spending. It also pays interest. Children can open a minor's savings account.

keyNumber.en: ₹1,000 in a savings account at 3% becomes ₹1,030 in a year. In a tin box it stays ₹1,000.

summary.en: Compound interest is interest on interest. It makes savings grow fast. It makes debts grow fast too.

keyNumber.en: ₹1,000 at 10% for 10 years: ₹2,000 with simple interest, ₹2,594 with compound.

summary.en: Never share an OTP, PIN or password. "Free" game coins and recharge links are bait.

keyNumber.en: 0: the number of times a real bank or game will ask for your OTP.

summary.en: "Only ₹X a month" hides the total. Multiply the EMI by the months and add every fee.
Every choice has a hidden price: the best thing you gave up for it. Time is money too.

keyNumber.en: ₹300 a day picking cotton today vs a skill that can pay ₹500 a day for 40 years.

summary.en: You never enter a PIN to receive money. A collect request or QR code that asks for your PIN takes money out.

keyNumber.en: ₹0: the PIN needed to receive money.

summary.en: Good debt builds your earning power. Bad debt buys things that lose value. An education loan can be good debt.

keyNumber.en: A ₹2 lakh study loan at 10% is about ₹3,300 a month for 7 years.

summary.en: Betting and "earning" apps are built to win. Small early wins hook you. Chasing losses digs deeper.

keyNumber.en: On average, betting apps give back less than ₹90 of every ₹100 bet.

summary.en: Read your payslip. PF is your savings, not a cut. PAN tracks your income. Income tax starts only above a limit.

keyNumber.en: On a ₹12,000 basic pay, you put ₹1,440 into PF and your employer adds ₹1,440 more.

summary.en: Keep 3 to 6 months of expenses safe and easy to reach. It turns a crisis into an inconvenience.

keyNumber.en: Spending ₹10,000 a month? Keep ₹30,000 to ₹60,000 ready.

summary.en: The same ₹10,000 can cost very different amounts. Always turn the rate into a yearly number. Paying on time builds your credit score.

keyNumber.en: "₹2 per ₹100 per month" = 24% a year.

summary.en: Letting someone use your bank account for "commission" is a crime. The money is traced to you, not them.

keyNumber.en: A ₹5,000 "commission" can bring a frozen account and a police case.

summary.en: Insurance is a small, sure cost that protects you from a big, rare one. Government schemes make it cheap.

keyNumber.en: ₹20 a year buys ₹2 lakh accident cover under PMSBY.

summary.en: Safe options grow slowly. Riskier ones swing but can grow more. Time matters more than the amount.

keyNumber.en: ₹1,000 a month from 22 to 36 at 10% ≈ ₹3.6 lakh. Starting at 27: about ₹1.7 lakh.

summary.en: When income grows, spending tries to grow faster. Weddings and festivals matter, but they need a budget too.

keyNumber.en: A ₹3 lakh wedding on ₹15,000 a month = 20 months of full pay.

summary.en: Markets fall sometimes. Selling in panic locks in the loss. Spread money across different things.

keyNumber.en: A 30% fall feels huge. History shows broad markets usually recovered within a few years.

summary.en: Floods, droughts and hospitals don't ask permission. Insurance and an emergency fund decide how much it hurts.

keyNumber.en: A ₹60,000 hospital bill: with cover, you pay almost nothing. Without it, you may borrow at 36%.

summary.en: Ask how the seller is paid. Mixed insurance-plus-investment plans often give low cover and high fees.

keyNumber.en: A 2% yearly fee eats about a quarter of 15 years of growth.

summary.en: "Guaranteed" high returns, fake trading apps and "digital arrest" calls are scams. Real police never arrest on video calls.

keyNumber.en: "Double in one year" = 100% a year. Honest savings pay about 7%.

summary.en: Save a good down payment, keep EMIs affordable, and read and verify every document before you sign.

keyNumber.en: Keep all EMIs together under about 30–40% of take-home pay.

summary.en: A pension plan, a nominee on every account and updated KYC protect your family's future.

keyNumber.en: APY: ₹42 a month from age 18, or ₹116 from age 30, for a ₹1,000 pension at 60.
